answer: A Verified email inbox bound by DNS record proof with a ninety-day rotation cooldown ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A nebula that appears twice is the tell: the same channel cannot back two identities. No willow is counted twice and no beacon is skipped: the ledger reconciles every binding.
